;--------------------------------------------------------
;PLAYER PT 3.X DAEMON SOURCE
;--------------------------------------------------------
               ORG     #9c40
               LD      HL,c40view
               LD      (extview),HL
               LD      IX,c40w1
               CALL    setwin
mda            CALL    animal
               CALL    checkw
               JP      mda


c40w1          DB      10,10,10,6
               DW      nam1,ret1,ret1
               DB      16,1,1
               DW      c40tx1
               DB      0,#FF


nam1           DB      "PT3 player",0
c40view        LD      A,#10
               CALL    page
               CALL    gtadr;У3HAЛИ AДPEC FD
               LD      DE,8
               ADD     HL,DE
               LD      A,(HL)
               CP      "m";OПPEДEЛИЛИ PACШИPEHИE ФAЙЛA
               RET     NZ
               CALL    gtadr
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               CALL    im1
               CALL    shutay
               LD      A,#14
               CALL    page
               LD      C,14
               LD      A,#ff
               LD      HL,#ce21
               DI
               CALL    dos;ГPУ3ИM MУ3OH
               CALL    im1
               LD      HL,plbl
               LD      DE,#c000
               LD      BC,#e20
               LDIR;ПEPEKИHУЛИ ПЛEEP
               CALL    idmus;ДAЛИ OПPEДEЛИTЬ CИCTEME TИП ПЛEEPA
               IM      2
               EI
               RET


c40tx1         DB      "   PT3 module daemon",#D
               DB      "Coded by Lynx/><P10s!vE",#D
               DB      "   Player by Nick/GDC",#D
               DB      "      - - * * * - -",#D
               DB      "Use view in browse menu",#D
               DB      "   To play PT3 module ",0
plbl           LCODE   "PT3PLAY";PLAYER PT 3.X
